bugs_found: apply_fee converts fee_min via Decimal(float(fee_min)), introducing binary floating-point precision artifacts; use Decimal(str(fee_min)) like the other inputs.
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so passing a float can raise TypeError during Decimal arithmetic and Receipt.amount may have an inconsistent type.
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min/fee_max or fee_pct produce a fee greater than the amount; fee should likely be capped at the amount or rejected.
